object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests. Files git ignores aren't tested; see the gaps.
object.description: In a committed document, change an object file; set a figure (with draw.io's .$ backup beside it); change only the manifest; stage a new object file from a git client; delete a file; change a file in a document whose ID is a prefix of another's. Open the commit dialog (or list the document's changes) each time. Expected: exactly the changed, added, deleted and staged files of the open document's folder are listed; the side file and files of other documents, including the one sharing the prefix, aren't; a clean document lists none.
